metadata.name: [GCP Cloud SQL PostgreSQL OTel] Memory utilization high
metadata.description: Alerts when the average memory utilization (excluding buffer/cache) of a PostgreSQL instance is at or above 90%, averaged over the samples in the 15-minute rule window (about 6-11 minutes of data, because Cloud Monitoring data arrives in 5-minute batches 3-9 minutes late), for 2 consecutive checks (about 11-16 minutes of data in total). Sustained memory pressure precedes OOM restarts. Requires at least 5 samples and applies the PostgreSQL engine marker. Grouped by database_id. Instances that report a memory quota under 1 GB (shared-core db-f1-micro) are excluded because they report memory pinned at the quota; instances without memory/quota data are still evaluated.

query.base:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
// Exact mean across fragments: SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME), not AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME)
| STATS mem_sum = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)),
        mem_n = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)),
        mem_peak = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)),
        quota = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/quota`)),
        pg = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/num_backends`))
    BY database_id

data.content:
## Cloud SQL PostgreSQL memory utilization high

`memory/utilization` excludes buffer/cache, so a sustained value near 100% is real memory pressure and risks an OOM restart.

### Triage
1. On the Instance Detail dashboard, check connections (`num_backends`) and temp spill: many connections times a large `work_mem` is the most common cause.
2. Look for large queries, sorts or hash joins (Query Insights if enabled).
3. Reduce connections (use a pooler), lower `work_mem` / `maintenance_work_mem`, or move to a larger tier.
4. If the instance already restarted, see the instance restarted alert.

### Tuning
- Shared-core db-f1-micro instances (under 1 GB) report memory pinned at the quota and are excluded by the `quota IS NULL OR quota >= 1000000000` filter. Instances without `memory/quota` data are still evaluated. Remove the filter to include db-f1-micro instances.
